messages:
Bea (eng-platform): noticing weird chart: p95 dips below p50 for a short period on the endpoint breakdown. Only in the cohort overlay.
Chen (backend): that sounds like merged sketches with heavy fragmentation. Client returns tiny tdigest pieces and UI re-merges them -> possible inversion.
Aria (console): UI default is merge=client for lower bandwidth. Can you repro by forcing merge=server?
Bea (eng-platform): forced server_merge=true and the curve looks normal (p50<p95<p99). So client-merge is the culprit.
Sam (telemetry): action items: emit fragment_count and sketch_size in ingestion metadata, and surface when many tiny fragments are merged.
Chen (backend): I'll ensure route_variant tag is attached before sketches are serialized so we can breakdown by variant at query time.
Aria (console): immediate UX: add an "aggregation: client/sketches" pill and a tiny warning badge when fragments>10 and total_samples<1k. I'll ship a small patch.
Bea (eng-platform): also adding a short note in the dashboard: "Tail percentiles may be underestimated when client-side sketches are heavily fragmented."
deploy-bot: ci passed for aria/frag-pill PR #4233  staging deploy scheduled. :rocket:
